title: Assignment-scope declaration slot, mode enum and ScopesPlugin
summary: Core interprets assignment scopes from one per-panel `Context\AssignmentScopeDeclaration` (closed `AssignmentScopeMode`, definitions by alias, per-alias directories, optional evaluator) contributed through `PanelBuilder::assignmentScopes()`; the scope DSL `AssignmentScopePolicy` becomes the module plugin `Scopes\ScopesPlugin` that contributes the declaration and `Scopes\Internal\ScopesOptions`; every mode read in core uses the enum and the envelope is computed by core from it.
why: D7/architecture#scope-boundary: the mode is interpreted over core columns in every path (frame, boundary, visibility, admission, validator), so the vocabulary and envelope belong to core while the DSL is module behavior; core must not import `AssignmentScopePolicy` (I2 entries owner P2). Hard risks: the existing precedence/conflict rules of `PanelCompiler::scopePolicy()/scopes()` must be preserved exactly; no declaration must mean `None` and fail closed (I7); the parity matrix must stay identical.

include: PanelCompiler merges declarations by layer with the existing rules: mode by precedence, definitions unioned with the sameness check, plugin-only mode conflicts rejected, at most one evaluator (conflicting evaluators → `DefinitionException`); per-alias directories union with conflict rejection

Rename `Scopes\AssignmentScopePolicy` → `Scopes\ScopesPlugin` (Api, id `azguard/scopes`, knowledge/contracts#scopes-plugin): static `inherit|isolated|required`, `requireMembership`, `accessAdapter` keep their parameter names; `register()` contributes the declaration (evaluator `null` in this item; P2.8 sets `ScopeEvaluator::class`), per-alias default directories, and `options(new ScopesOptions(membership, adapters))`; class-string<Model> definitions are wrapped into `ModelAssignmentScopeDefinition` inside the module; `none()` has no equivalent

Core mode reads switched to the enum and declaration: `EvaluationFrame::sourceScopes()` (envelope), `BoundaryStage`, `Visibility`, `PanelAdmission`, `ChangeValidator`, `Context\Internal\WithinContext`, `RoleCompiler`, `SchemaBuilder`; module-owned data (membership, adapters) read from `ScopesOptions` only by module code or by the existing call sites still allowlisted with owner P3
Folder-discovered `Scopes/` definitions still never become declared aliases (Formats/scopes-discovery.json unchanged)

All tests/fixtures/bench/docs: `->scopes(AssignmentScopePolicy::x(...))` → `->plugins([ScopesPlugin::x(...)])`, `AssignmentScopePolicy::none()` → no plugin; I2 entries for Panel.php/PanelBuilder.php/PanelCompiler.php → removed
Migration lines: scopes() → ScopesPlugin / assignmentScopes(); mode strings → AssignmentScopeMode
exclude: The evaluator contract and call-site switch from ScopeEligibility (P2.8)
